profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Toyota Connected North America
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a Masters of Science in Information Systems Engineering with a track in Software Engineering, at Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering. Experience in designing, developing, and supporting Telematics Services Platform, CRM, and Ecommerce applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Developed and successfully launched the TSP (Telematics Services Platform) for Toyota North Americas. More specifically, I have helped develop the Safety Services (Automatic Collision Notification and SOS), Stolen Vehicle Locator, and the CRM using Spring Microservices and Salesforce Lightning.

I have also been a part of creating and maintaining our CI/CD pipeline and have gotten Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure experience. 

Collaboration with hardware teams during testing to prepare for the TSP's launch at Toyota manufacturing plants. In addition, I am currently engaged in enhancing, testing, and supporting the TSP in production and ensuring we meet 99.9999% uptime. 

Other tools/technologies used - Datadog, MongoDB, CosmosDB, VueJS, Azure Service Bus, Golang, Terraform, CircleCi, Spinnaker (CD), and Gitlab CI/CD.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Development in front-end languages and Java to deliver enhancements for monthly release sprints.
Development of reusable AEM components.
As part of a quick time to market company-wide initiative, design and develop Shopify websites. 
Instrumental in special projects and proof of concepts for executives.
Collaboration and knowledge transfers with global business partners and offshore teams.
Collaboration with business and creative/brand teams.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
Completed Intern innovation project involving branding, design, marketing, and Ecommerce
Presented to the CEO and other executives
Supported existing Ecommerce solutions using AEM
Delivered web enhancements 	
Developed proof of concept for high visibility project (Shopify)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Specialized in organic shape memory polymers and the creation of polymers using thiol ene reactions that can be implanted as neural interface devices
